name: TZM1026_Fingerprint
description: High-performance, production-ready Arduino & PlatformIO driver library for BIOSEC TM1026M / TZM1026_V1.0 capacitive semiconductor fingerprint sensor (chip BIOSEC TA0702 / TA0982, sensor TS1026M). Implements SFM-V1.7 protocol with 3C3R/5C5R enrollment, raw image extraction, role management, and AI self-learning.
keywords: fingerprint, biosec, tzm1026, tm1026m, ta0702, capacitive, biometric, esp32, esp32-c3, arduino, smartkey
